nom: TONYMOLY Wonder Ceramide Mochi Micellar Foam Cleanser

avis.texte: I find that most cleansers leave my skin feeling parched. But I fell in love with this product because it is the perfect a balance of cleansing without stripping all of the natural oils. The scent is nice too, not overwhelming. This has become a staple in my daily routine.

I highly recommend this product for those with combination skin. The formula is lightweight yet effective, making it ideal for balancing the skin without feeling heavy. If you have dry skin, you may prefer a richer cleanser for added hydration. For oily skin types, pairing this with a heavier cleanser, such as an oil-based cleanser, can help maintain balance since this product cleanses gently without removing a lot of oil.

avis.titre: Part of my double cleanse step
avis.texte: I love this face wash. I need this as part of my routine to remove makeup. This leaves me really clean feeling without me feeling dry. I don't mind the smell, but my husband borrowed this once and he said it smelled like black pepper. After he said that I can honestly smell it too but I don't mind.
So gentle and rich! Love everything about this product including the fact it zero to very little sceng

I've been using this for about a year and so far it has become my favorite foam cleanser! My face has such sensitive skin that I always worry about certain products, but I have no worries with this cleanser at all. The foam is so gentle, and I do feel clean and refreshed after using it.

avis.titre: I love this product and the entire line
avis.texte: This product was such a pleasant surprise. I got it as part of a TONYMOLY bundle and when I tried it I was so surprised at how soft and clean my skin was. It's a foam cleanser (great for oily skin), so you tend to notice some typical dryness with most foam cleansers but not at all with this one. It smelled light and clean, it left my skin feeling awesome, and a great price? I will be a lifelong customer. (I also use the wonder mochi toner and water cream, both are awesome products with a great smell, wonderful skin feel and perfect price point)
This is a great product for sensitive skin. Takes off makeup without harsh chemicals and stripping my skin.

avis.titre: SO GENTLE ON THE SKIN! I LOVE IT!
avis.texte: I really love how easy it is to use. It smells amazing too! The fluffy and thick texture makes my whole cleansing routine enjoyable :) It's not harsh on the skin but cleanses well.
I love this ceramide micellar foam cleanser because it gets the job done! This is one of my favorite cleansers! It doesn't break my skin out and it's super lightweight! I love that it foams!

I was researching K-beauty skincare because of my younger sister and omg... the price is super accessible, lasts a ton because of the texture, and leaves your skin feeling clean and doesn't dry it up. 10/10 ✨️

It looks pretty and cleanses well, but the smell is very strong and unpleasant. It smells like coriander, but not in a good natural way. It smells very chemical. I will use it up but won't be repurchasing.
Love this cleanser. I wish they made a bigger bottle because it runs out fast.

I use a medical grade skincare cleanser but was tired of double cleansing with something so expensive, so I bought this to get the bulk of my makeup off first. Unfortunately, the smell is gross and it gave me bumps on my forehead. Not pimples or irritation— just small bumps in the skin. Once I went back to my expensive stuff only, the bumps cleared up. Bummer, will be returning.

I grabbed this product on a whim, not really thinkib much, just needed a cleanser quick and it was available. To my surprise - its my favorite cleanswr now. Super gentle yet very effective, takes off my makeup and spf bery easily (i still double cleanse but i dont need to scrub hard with it). My skin feels supple yet very clean. Totally would recommend!

After a week of using this product I noticed my pores had gotten so luch smaller. My skin feeks hydrated and fresh I love it so much. Ive commited to the entire Wonder skin set and its worked WONDERS.

I have acne prone combo skin that is very sensitive. I use the Peach & Lily cleanser but needed something cheaper for the moment so I decided to try this. I noticed right away it has a very airy, fluffy foam which I liked. I don't need much. It did effectively remove my makeup, mascara included very easily. I always double cleanse with a balm but wanted to really test it out. It also has the same fresh, citrus scent that their mochi ceramide cream has. It's subtle and I don't mind. It can be a tad more drying than the P&L but doesn't feel right if you don't use too much. I noticed with just the few times I've used it so far, my advice acne has already improved. It has niacinamide which I love. The P&L is a pretty basic cleanser so I love that it includes the niacinamide for my acne. Given the price I make actually switch from the P&L due to the price and the Tony Moly having lore to offer as far as ingredients!

I've been using Tonymoly Nourish & cleanse with gentle ceramide bubbles for several weeks now, and I'm thrilled with the results. This cleanser has truly transformed my skincare routine. Not only does it effectively remove makeup and impurities, but it also leaves my skin feeling incredibly clean and refreshed without any tightness or dryness. The formula is gentle yet powerful, and I love how it lathers into a creamy foam that rinses off easily. It has a light, pleasant scent that adds to the overall luxurious experience of using it. My complexion looks clearer and more radiant since I started using this cleanser, and I've even noticed a reduction in breakouts. I highly recommend Tonymoly cleanserto anyone looking for a cleanser that delivers both effective cleansing and skincare benefits. Gifted by Tonymoly

I received this Wonder Ceramide Mochi Gentle Foam Cleanser to try out and review complimentary from TONYMOLY Skincare in exchange for my honest opinion. I really like that this face cleanser is so gentle and refreshing and is good for sensitive skin! It has a nice very light scent so it's not overpowering at all. I would recommend this cleanser.

Tonymoly gifted me their wonder ceramide gentle foam cleanser & within the first 3 days of use I saw a huge difference in texture. Smelled amazing & it really does leave your face feeling like moshi!!

I was gifted by tonymoly this foaming cleanser and Im very impressed by it! The foam cleanser felt so nice snd gentle on my skin compared to other formulas and left my skin feeling so clean without drying it out

This foam cleanser is a game changer for me. My skin feels so plump and soft. It's insane. I've never had a cleanser that makes my skin feel this great. I'm using it every morning and every night and I can notice a difference between the collagen and the aloe with how noticeably healthy my skin looks now. I seriously feel like I'm not messing my skin up…I'm not having bad reactions and I'm so happy with the results A+. Gifted by tonymoly

This foam cleanser is actually really nice. The smell is okay not something I would really like. But the foaminess texture is so fun!! You can use it all over and it's very soft. I 100 percent recommend this product! Gifted by tonymoly

I love this cleaner! It left my face feeling so clean & not oily! I will absolutely purchase this & use it!! It's my new favorite cleanser. Im so glad I was gifted by Tonymoly wonder ceramide gentle foam cleanser!

I was gifted by Tonymoly for an honest review. First and foremost, I love the texture of this cleanser! It's fluffy, soft, and so fun to play with before washing my face. It has a pleasant and subtle scent that doesn't irritate my skin. Most importantly, it leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed without that stripped feeling! It's affordability is another plus!!!

Wow! For me, just one pump of this cleanser is enough for my entire face. I love the mildness of this cleanser. It makes my skin feel relaxed, balanced, and nourished, and it has helped my hormonal acne. I am incorporating it in the mornings and nights, and it leaves my skin clean and fresh. I received this product complimentary from Tony Moly.

This is a unique cleanser as it starts as this silky oil that melts away all my makeup (even waterproof mascara!), and then it transforms into a gentle foam when you add water. My skin feels so clean and soft afterwards, not stripped at all. Plus, it smells amazing, like a mini spa experience every time I use it. Highly recommend for anyone looking for an effective yet gentle cleanser. Gifted by Tonymoly.

The Wonder Ceramide Gentle Foam Cleanser gifted by tonymoly effectively cleanses without stripping oils, making it ideal for thorough cleansing. However, its formulation can be drying for those with dry skin, necessitating careful moisturization post-use.

Gifted by Tony Moly. I've been using this his face cleanser for a few days now and I absolutely love it. The foam is very gentle on my skin and doesn't cause any irritations. It leaves my skin clean and soft.

This is very soft and gentle. And lathers much more than I thought it would. Even 1 pump is a lot. Half a pump is enough. It also cleans very well. Feels squeaky clean without feeling drying nor too stripping. Gifted by Tony moly

Gifted by TonyMoly. Such a perfect and light face cleanser! This cleanser is perfect for double cleansing and doesn't leave my face feeling dry which is a HUGE plus. Love the texture of it and definitely recommend

Gifted by TonyMoly. My skin is pretty sensitive so I am always a little weary trying new things. Love that it didn't irritate my skin at all. I found a little went a long way and it left my skin feeling so soft and hydrated!

This is a great cleanser and I enjoy using it after I take off my makeup. It's great because it does not prelate the skin and doesn't strip the oils. Recommend for anyone looking for a cleanser. Offered by tonymoly

I recently tried the Tony Moly Wonder Ceramide Mochi Gentle Foam Cleanser, and I am thoroughly impressed. From the first use, I noticed how incredibly soft and plush the foam felt against my skin. As someone with sensitive skin, I was relieved to find that this cleanser is as gentle as advertised. The combination of Ceramides and Collagen really works wonders, leaving my skin feeling plump and hydrated after each wash. The inclusion of Niacinamide and Centella Asiatica (Cica) Extract has been a game-changer for calming and soothing my skin. Any redness I had seemed to diminish significantly. I also appreciate the added benefits from Aloe Leaf Extract and Olive Oil, which contribute to a nourishing and moisturizing cleanse without any greasy residue. At 150ml, the cleanser is a decent size, ensuring it will last a good while even with daily use. The experience of using this product is truly luxurious, living up to its promise of making my skin feel as soft and smooth as mochi. Overall, the Tony Moly Ceramide Cleanser has become a staple in my skincare routine, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle yet effective cleansing solution. Gifted by Tonymoly.

I've been using the Wonder Ceramide Mochi Gentle Foam Cleanser, and it's a fantastic addition to my skincare routine. This cleanser's soft foam formula is incredibly gentle, making it suitable even for my sensitive skin. The ingredients are what truly set this cleanser apart. Ceramides help to strengthen the skin barrier, while Collagen and Niacinamide work together to improve skin elasticity and brighten my complexion. The inclusion of Centella Asiatica (Cica) Extract and Aloe Leaf Extract provides soothing benefits, calming any redness or irritation. Olive Oil adds a touch of moisture, ensuring my skin feels hydrated and not stripped after cleansing. At 150ml, the size is generous and lasts a good while.
packaging is cute, feels amazing and foamy, clears my skin. new fav cleanser

I purchased this product myself. The foam is super soft, small cell structure. My skin never feels dry or stripped when I'm done washing my face. I use it every morning, and it's been a great experience. It may not last as long as other cleansers for the price, but it's worth it.

Trust me, you need this cleanser in your life. New favorite skin care product! This doesn't make me break out and basically everything makes me break out. It's so gentle! This cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean, but not dried out. 10 out of 10, would reccommend.

leaves your skin soft after every wash, and it pairs well when double cleansing with any cleanser! Hands down the best cleanser I have used in a long while! Anyone who hasnt tried it should give it a go!

Love the how soft and fluffy the foam is coming out of the bottle. The foam feels super comfortable and gentle on the skin. However, it does cleanser vey well – my t-zone can be oily and this removes all the grease. It has a light scent that's pleasant. I think it would be suitable for most skin types. (Gifted by Wonder for my honest opinions).

avis.titre: Love the ingredients such as aloe extract, olive oil!
avis.texte: Gifted by Tonymoly. I love the quality of skincare products by Tonymoly. This wonder ceramide gentle foam cleanser has so many amazing ingredients like niacinamide, olive oil, and aloe leaf extract. It leaves the skin clean yet soothes it. It is perfectly safe for sensitive skin. I am in love with it.

I really enjoy this new cleanser. I have very oily skin and it's super sensitive and this is nice. I like the packaging and it does a good job cleansing the skin without stripping it. Gifted by tonymoly

avis.titre: If you have Combination Skin this is for you !
avis.texte: This foam cleanser is great for people with combination skin and sensitive skin. Like me I cannot use a lot of products because it will break me out, I used this product for the last 2 weeks with 0 breakouts and it keeps my face looking even and refreshing . It works well by its self and with other cleansers. Definitely a GREAT buy "Gifted By TonyMoly"

Wonder Ceramide Mochi Gentle Foam Cleanser is an exceptional product that deserves a glowing review. This cleanser not only effectively removes dirt, oil, and impurities from the skin but also leaves it feeling incredibly soft and nourished. The unique mochi-like texture of the foam provides a luxurious and gentle cleansing experience. One of the standout features of this cleanser is its use of ceramides, which are essential for maintaining a healthy skin barrier. The Wonder Ceramide Mochi Gentle Foam Cleanser is packed with ceramides that help to strengthen and protect the skin, leaving it hydrated and plump. I also appreciate that this cleanser is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It is free from harsh ingredients that can cause irritation or dryness, making it a gentle yet effective option for daily cleansing. The scent of this cleanser is light and refreshing, adding to the overall pleasant experience. The packaging is also sleek and practical, making it easy to dispense and use. Overall, I highly recommend the Wonder Ceramide Mochi Gentle Foam Cleanser. It not only cleanses the skin thoroughly but also nourishes and protects it, resulting in a healthy and radiant complexion.

This cleanser is extremely hydrating while at the same time doing a great job removing your makeup. The Niacinamide is a nice bonus as it gives the skin a brightening effect. I love using this cleanser both day and night. Offered by Tonymoly

This face wash is so nice and feels amazing on the skin! I love the foamy texture of it and it smells light and fresh which is nice! It also leaves my skin feeling soft and clean! Really nice cleanser definitely recommend trying! This was gifted to me!

This cleanser is so foamy and lathers so much, I'm obsessed. It's gentle but makes my skin feel so clean and refreshed. It has a lot of awesome ingredients that help protect my skin barrier and improve elasticity, etc, but I specifically love how gentle it feels most of all. My skin doesn't feel stripped or dried out, but it also is so effective. Will definitely be repurchasing this one!

Gentle moisturizer, doesn't strip skin or leave dry. I have very sensitive skin & it works like a charm! I was gifted by Tony moly but really love still nonetheless. Truth is in the pudding!! Recommend 100%!

I tried the wonder foam cleanser gifted by TonyMoly. I love the look of it on my bathroom counter, it's pink and pretty. It's a gentle cleanser and I used it first thing in the morning. My face felt clean, fresh and plump after using it. It has ceramides, niacinamide, aloe and olive oil. Perfect for my skin which tends to get dry. It's hydrating and a great face cleanser.

I love this cleanser so much! I wasn't sure what to expect because it is so accessible and affordable but this facial cleanser has become such a staple in my skincare routine. It is a lightweight and easy to use foam that thoroughly cleanses and feels so gentle! I am absolutely obsessed and will continue to use. Gifted by Tony Moly!

avis.titre: Softer, brighter & cleaner skin, sensitive skin friendly
avis.texte: Details: This is formulated to be gentle for sensitive skin. Designed to leave skin as soft & plump as a mochi while removing dirt & bacteria. Key ingredients include ceramides, collagen, niacinamide, centella asiatica (Cica) Extract, aloe leaf extract, & olive oil. Ceramide hydrates & softens skin, collagen aids with wrinkles & increasing elasticity, niacinamide brightens & improves the skin's barrier, centella calms skin & promotes collagen production, aloe soothes & hydrates, & olive oil is anti-inflammatory. For reference, I have combination, acne prone skin with some sensitivity. I have been using this as a second step cleanser after a cleansing balm. It has a subtle yet refreshing citrus scent I love. The pump top creates a fluffy soft foam (swipe for video) that removes remaining dirt & oil. My skin is left clean, brighter & softer. It is not as hydrating as my HG foam cleanser but doesn't leave skin dry or tight either. Overall: I am really enjoying this cleanser & how my skin looks & feels. It's cleaner, softer & brighter & and good choice to use as a second step cleanser. Have you tried anything from this launch yet?

Gifted by TonyMoly. This was a fabulous gentle foam cleanser that left my skin feeling completely clean as well as nourished. I was incredibly happy and will definitely look at repurchasing this one again

This ceramide foam cleanser is very gentle on my acne prone skin and makes my skin feel very soft. I like the foam and I only need a little bit of the cleanser. I like using this morning and evening. Gifted by Tony Moly.

This product is gifted by Tonymoly. This foaming cleanser is gentle on my skin and packed with great ingredients. I was surprised to see olive oil on the ingredients list because I use it to keep moisturized during the night.

This cleanser is seriously my new favorite! The foamy texture feels amazing, and the scent is just perfect – not too strong, but enough to make it a pleasant experience. I was surprised at how clear and fresh my usually oily skin looked after just one use. Plus, being gentle on the skin, it's a must-try for all you sensitive skin ladies out there. Trust me, highly recommend adding this gem to your skincare routine! Gifted by tonymoly

I received the ceramide mochi gentle foam cleanser complimentary from tonymoly in exchange for my honest review. Love this cleanser. It's very gentle on skin and adds a lot of hydration back in. And with the added collagen benefits you can't go wrong.

I was gifted by TONYMOLY for my honest review. This foaming cleanser is super soft! When I took it out of the packaging and opened the lid my sister even said that it smells just like mochi ice cream! Definitely a new favorite.

avis.titre: I can just say that I love it
avis.texte: This product is gifted by tonymoly and now I'm obsessed with it. First of all, the texture is heavenly. The soft foam feels like a gentle cloud on my skin—so luxurious and comforting. And despite its gentleness, it's incredibly effective at cleansing away impurities without leaving my skin feeling dry or tight. But what really blew me away are the results. My skin has never felt so soft and plump! I'm talking mochi-level softness here. And the best part? It's suitable for even the most sensitive skin types, thanks to its carefully selected ingredients like Ceramides, Collagen, Niacinamide, Centella Asiatica Extract, Aloe Leaf Extract, and Olive Oil. I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's texture and overall appearance since I started using this cleanser.

I love a good foam cleanser! It's light but does the job when I double cleanse! I use this after my oil cleanser and it helps keep my skin clear and without breaking out. Recommend!! I was gifted by Tony moly!

This a nice size bottle! That was very nice to see but I love how foamy this cleanser gets! I like the light scent and makes my face look so healthy right after. I definitely recommend if u have sensitive skin gifted by tontmy

I have really dry skin so I was a little bit nervous about using a foam cleanser because they can be drying. However, I was pleasantly surprised by this one it completely removed my make up and my skin did not feel overly tight and dry at all. Gifted by Tony moly
